integrity.claim_evidence: Analytic renewal identity, positive Gamma-Laplace covariance kernel, dominated spectral-edge expansion, and exact tilted-spectrum variance identity in RESULT.md; 40 independent diagnostic assertions in checker.py.
integrity.originality_scope: New asserted content concerns the two-time stationary covariance spectrum and its decay; known one-time marginals and general reset-spectral facts are not claimed.
integrity.source_model_attribution: Bodrova, Chechkin and Dubey, arXiv:2403.18974, establish the one-time cooling-reset model and mean/variance.

scientific_limitations: Applies to exact Poisson resets of one scalar temperature with deterministic Haff-type cooling and fixed positive parameters; not a microscopic noisy granular-gas theorem.
The spectral density is the positive exponential-mixture measure of the stationary temperature covariance, not an assertion about the point spectrum of a reversible evolution operator.
No quantitative finite-sample or simultaneous large-time/parameter-limit guarantee is established. Independent publication-priority review remains outstanding.
title: A continuous relaxation spectrum and a sharp cubic correlation tail for a reset-cooled granular gas
